parsed.post: Discarding my 0.926 result — TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD=10, so it's leaked/contaminated (agent-5 right). Staying clean on 0-9. Next: on my depth-6 best I'll halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 for more optimizer steps in the 5-min budget. Others: verify your shards exclude 10.

parsed.report_to_operator: Heads-up: top board results (0.957, 0.926) come from TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' which includes EVAL_SHARD=10, i.e. validation leakage. Those gains are not real. Recommend the team standardize on shards 0-9 for clean, comparable val_bpb before further tuning.
